ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping District; B1-5, Neighborhood Shopping District; B3-1, Community
Shopping District; and B3-2, Community Shopping District, symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 10-D and Map No. 10-E in the area bound by:

   East 43rd Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Drexel Boulevard; the alley
   next north of and parallel to East 44th Street; the alley next west of and parallel to
   South Cottage Grove Avenue; East 44th Street; the alley next east of and parallel to
   South Cottage Grove; East 45th Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South
   Cottage Grove; East 46th Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Cottage
   Grove; the alley next north of and parallel to East 47th Street; the alley next west of and
   parallel to South Drexel Boulevard; a line 260 feet north of and parallel to East 47th
   Street; South Drexel Boulevard; East 47th Street; the alley next west of and parallel to
   South Drexel Boulevard; the alley next south of and parallel to East 47th Street; the
   alley next east of and parallel to South Cottage Grove Avenue; East 47th Place; South
   Cottage Grove Avenue; East 47th Street; South Evans Avenue; the alley next north of
   and parallel to East 47th Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Cottage
   Grove Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to East 46th Street; the alley next
   west of and parallel to South Cottage Grove Avenue; a line 188 feet north of and
   parallel to East 46th Street; South Cottage Grove Avenue; a line 236 feet north of and
   parallel to East 46th Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Cottage Grove
   Avenue; a line 260 feet north of and parallel to East 46th Street; South Cottage Grove
   Avenue; a line 308 feet north of and parallel to East 46th Street; the alley next west of
   and parallel to South Cottage Grove Avenue; East 45th Street; South Cottage Grove
   Avenue; East 44th Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Cottage Grove
   Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to East 43rd Street; and South Evans
   Avenue,

       to those of a B3-3, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                              Lamont J. Robinson
                                                              Alderman, 4th Ward
